summary.text: Greg Sargent is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 7 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gregory Sargent earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire and a law degree from the Boston University School of Law, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
He took office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
